invoices_party_matches_kind.name: invoices_party_matches_kind
invoices_party_matches_kind.value:
("invoices"."kind" = 'sales' and "invoices"."customer_id" is not null and "invoices"."supplier_id" is null and "invoices"."delivery_id" is not null and "invoices"."receipt_id" is null)
        or ("invoices"."kind" = 'purchase' and "invoices"."supplier_id" is not null and "invoices"."customer_id" is null and "invoices"."receipt_id" is not null and "invoices"."delivery_id" is null)

payments_void_complete.name: payments_void_complete
payments_void_complete.value:
("payments"."voided_at" is null and "payments"."voided_by" is null and "payments"."void_reason" is null)
        or ("payments"."voided_at" is not null and "payments"."voided_by" is not null and "payments"."void_reason" is not null)

payroll_runs_state.name: payroll_runs_state
payroll_runs_state.value:
case "payroll_runs"."status"
        when 'draft' then "payroll_runs"."approved_by" is null and "payroll_runs"."paid_by" is null
        when 'approved' then "payroll_runs"."approved_by" is not null and "payroll_runs"."approve_entry_id" is not null and "payroll_runs"."paid_by" is null
        when 'paid' then "payroll_runs"."approved_by" is not null and "payroll_runs"."paid_by" is not null and "payroll_runs"."pay_entry_id" is not null
        else "payroll_runs"."cancelled_at" is not null
      end
